outcome: quality of care (QoC) for maternal and newborn health (MNH) services
cohort: 228 cases of MNH services in a district hospital and a mother and child welfare centre in Bangladesh
finding: The overall quality of care (QoC) for maternal and newborn health (MNH) services was moderate in both facilities (54.8% in the district hospital and 56.1% in the mother and child welfare centre), with particularly low scores for antenatal and postnatal care.
